items.title: [Google Play 差评] ★1 The developer's greed and inability to b
items.summary: The developer's greed and inability to balance their own game ruined a decent little lovecraftian deck building game. If you enjoy grinding out currency to pull multiple copies of only the recent meta units while the rest of your roster gathers dust, so you can then slog through massively inflated hp bars of enemies that'll one shot you unless you have the battlepass exclusive rewind feature... you can probably find a higher production game that you'll enjoy more than this one.
items.author: Mim
